title: Publish CCP2 corpus catalog and provenance
description:
Scope: CCP entries in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/README.md and corpus-use instructions in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/ccp-conformance.md. Publish actual frozen family names, versions/digests, independent arithmetic/signature/state provenance, consumer locations and safe scoped check commands. Compare the catalog independently with the manifest and executed consumer records. Explicitly distinguish preserved legacy-policy and implementation-generated regression fixtures. No legacy expected bytes, broad generator output, unrelated vector family or source policy is changed by this documentation slice.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Update the existing vector catalog instead of adding another inventory system. Evidence describes verified work, not issue status or hypothetical consumers.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog entries agree with the real frozen corpus inventory and all three completed consumer artifacts. Check/regeneration commands reference supported existing entry points and do not require bulk sibling rewrites. Reused primitives have specific independent provenance; the legacy address constructor is not advertised as an upstream identity oracle. Legacy-policy tests remain clearly labeled and executable rather than silently counted as CCP2 passes. Local links and manifest/catalog consistency checks pass.
